description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.465.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '6a58feb0a195962881ebe7931fb133117266ddede226b994824af4d7639cb1fb') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.465.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '6a58feb0a195962881ebe7931fb133117266ddede226b994824af4d7639cb1fb') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.465.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'ece8a7b085fe42fe04e5c8ae2ee4dd02183da0ffc4df1493217973f510086b64') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
